summary_1line: The ascetic Jaratkaru learns his ancestors suffer for lack of descendants and reluctantly vows to marry to produce a son who will save them.

image_candidates.scene_text: Jaratkaru beholds his ancestors hanging upside down in a dark pit, clinging to a fraying root gnawed by a rat symbolizing Time.
The sorrowful sage Jaratkaru stands in the forest crying out three times to all creatures, begging for a bride to save his ancestors.
The serpent king Vasuki approaches the ascetic in the forest, presenting his ornamented sister as a bride offered like alms.
